meta.disclosure: Demonstration data. Sample automation requests with illustrative durations; no live telemetry.
meta.summary: Automation requests move from intake through AI-assisted scoping, a parallel governance fan-out, build, QA and UAT. Samples include QA and UAT rework loops.
meta.credits: Sample from the original AIxRay explorer by Doug Ross (MIT License).

details.desc: A business unit raises a request for a new RPA automation. This is the entry point into the Center of Excellence intake funnel.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The CoE intake team runs discovery workshops with the requesting business to understand the candidate process and confirm automation feasibility.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: A formal use case is captured in the automation pipeline manager (APM), logging scope, expected benefits and the process owner.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: An AI similarity-match engine scans the existing component and bot library to surface reusable assets relevant to the new use case.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: AI generates a build effort estimate based on process complexity and the reuse opportunities identified by the similarity match.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The business analyst elicits detailed functional requirements, capturing process steps, exceptions and data inputs for the automation.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: AI generates a first-draft Process Definition Document from the gathered requirements, accelerating documentation effort.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The business analyst reviews, corrects and finalizes the AI-drafted PDD, signing it off as the build specification.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Parallel split kicking off the governance and environment preparation activities concurrently.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Service accounts, credentials and system access required by the bot are provisioned across target applications.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The data handled by the automation is classified against information-security policy to determine handling and storage controls.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Governance and security pre-approvals are obtained from the relevant control owners before the build can proceed.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Parallel join synchronizing access provisioning, data classification and pre-approvals before development begins.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The developer builds the automation against the finalized PDD, reusing matched components where possible.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Quality assurance executes test cases against the built bot to verify it meets the documented requirements.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Exclusive decision: if QA passes the bot proceeds to UAT, otherwise it is returned to development for defect fixes.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The business performs user acceptance testing to confirm the automation works correctly against real-world scenarios.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: Exclusive decision: if the business accepts, the bot is deployed; if not, it is sent back to development for rework.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The accepted bot is promoted and deployed into the production automation environment.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

details.desc: The automation is live in production and actively executing in the RPA estate.

provenance.note: Generated sample. Descriptions and durations were written for the demonstration.

scenarios.name: Invoice Capture Bot
scenarios.summary: Clean run end-to-end. Passed QA first time and was accepted in UAT without rework, now live and processing AP invoices in production.
